turns.question: 讲义怎么定义 Acceptance Grid？配套 Latency replay 实验的 mean release lag 为多少毫秒？

reads.text:
Acceptance Grid
Field Operations Guide | section 09
Acceptance Grid: in the same epoch, both sensors must each be strictly above 23 units.
Equality on either sensor fails. Never average the two readings.
Operator review uses the defined condition for its own step. Do not transfer a rule
between acceptance, dispatch and logging. Each section is an independent reference for a
separate review.
Review order: identify the subject of the rule, then keep its event and boundary.
